description: This file contains a PHP class implementing a PHPStan rule to validate regex patterns used in static calls like preg and regex functions. It inspects static method calls, extracts regex patterns, and validates their correctness, reporting errors for invalid patterns.

classes.name: InvalidRegexPatternRule
classes.description: A PHPStan rule class that detects invalid regex patterns in static method calls to preg and regex functions, providing validation and error reporting.

methods.name: getNodeType
methods.description: Returns the node type this rule processes, which is StaticCall.

methods.name: processNode
methods.description: Processes a given PHP parser node, extracts regex patterns, and returns an array of rule errors if invalid patterns are found.

methods.name: extractPatterns
methods.description: Extracts regex pattern strings from static call nodes when they involve certain regex functions.

methods.name: validatePattern
methods.description: Validates a regex pattern string, returning an error message if invalid or null if valid.
